title: Design System: The Tooth Care by Dr. Uzzal

source.note: Derived from the shipped home-page prototype only. prototype/home.html and prototype/signature-blue.html are rejected alternates and were not consulted.

headline.purpose: Section headings; white on the navy closing panel, capped at 18ch.

title-serif.purpose: Named-person and named-place headings (dentist name, chamber names at a fixed 30px).

quote.purpose: Patient quotes in the display serif, ink, under a 2px brass rule.

numeral.purpose: Brass serif step numbers in the first-visit ledger.

title.purpose: Sans semibold step titles at 21px; index titles use the same weight at 18px.

body-lead.purpose: The single factual hero sentence, ink-soft, capped at 26em.

body.purpose: All running text, capped at 36em in descriptions and bios.

body-small.purpose: Roles, landmarks, chamber detail lists; index descriptions at 15px.

caption.purpose: Quote attributions, header phone links, footer text.

shadows.name: action-cast
shadows.purpose: Resting primary button on the ground. The only box-shadow in the system.

shadows.name: action-cast-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover, paired with translateY(-1px). Removed when the button is inverted on the navy panel.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out used for every transition and animation.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Button background, colour, transform, and shadow changes.

motion.name: duration-index-slide
motion.purpose: Treatments index row hover slide of 8px.

motion.name: duration-bar
motion.purpose: Phone bar show and hide (translateY(110%) plus opacity).

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Ledger settle-in: 16px rise, once, when it enters the viewport (rootMargin -10%, threshold 0.1, 2s fallback).

motion.name: duration-hero-rise
motion.purpose: Hero headline, sentence, and actions rise 14px; staggered 0 / 120ms / 220ms.

motion.name: duration-hero-unveil
motion.purpose: Hero photo unveils from clip-path inset(0 0 8% 0) to inset(0), delayed 160ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All entrance and reveal animations are declared inside this media query; under reduce, elements render in place with no animation.

breakpoints.name: columns
breakpoints.purpose: Treatments index, chamber blocks, and footer split into columns.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Header phones appear, hero and team go two-column, section heads 5/7, quotes three-up, ledger three-column, phone bar removed.

backdrop.name: bar-glass
backdrop.purpose: Fixed phone bar on screens under 900px.

standIns: Logo: inline stroke tooth SVG plus HTML wordmark; the real logo file replaces it.
Photography: warm putty gradient fields (#EAE4DA, #D9CFC1, #C9BCAA) with a translucent 'Photo to supply' caption; not system colours.
Unconfirmed facts (degrees, BMDC number, opening time, parking, reviewer first names, associate names) marked in brass italic via a .todo class; the marker leaves with the facts.
Fonts load from Google Fonts in the prototype; the Astro build owes self-hosted subsets of Libre Caslon Display and Schibsted Grotesk.
Tokens --rule-soft and --panel are declared but not consumed by the home page; --tint is used as a literal in the closing-panel button hover.

narrative.overview:
Confidence through restraint. The page reads as a high-end dental practice at a glance: a near-white ground, one large photograph, a light display serif for headings, hairline rules that divide instead of boxes that contain, and the logo navy spent only on actions and emphasis rules. It refuses both the crafty warm-clinic look and the loud blue-gradient chain.

Structure is typographic and ruled, not carded. Every section is a hairline-topped band on the same ground; inside, content sits in two-column grids (5/7, 6/6, 1/1) that collapse to one column on phones. Lists are ledgers and indexes: a numbered first-visit ledger, a two-column treatments index, three quote columns, two chamber blocks. Nothing floats, nothing is tiled, nothing carries an icon except the logo tooth and the WhatsApp mark inside the primary button.

Warmth comes from the serif, the brass numerals and quote rules, and warm-graded photography, not from colour or ornament. Motion is a single authored entrance (hero copy rises, hero photo unveils from a clipped bottom edge) plus one settle on the ledger; everything else is a 200ms state change. The register is premium and modern, not homely; the copy is plain clinic language and the visuals never shout over it.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white ground with a single white-on-navy closing panel; no other tonal blocks.
Hairline rules (1px) structure the page; 2px rules mark emphasis (brass on quotes, navy on chambers).
No cards, no icon tiles, no drop shadows on surfaces; the only shadow is a soft navy cast under the primary button.
Light display serif (weight 400) for every heading, numeral, and quote; a grotesk for everything read.
Navy is disciplined: primary button, links, section emphasis rules, focus ring, selection, scrollbar, closing panel.
Brass is rare and owns exactly three things: step numerals, quote rules, and unconfirmed-fact markers.
One entrance animation, exponential ease-out, fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Disciplined Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy fills exactly two things: the primary button and the closing panel. Everywhere else it is a line, an outline, or a word.

rules.name: The Brass Is Never a Fill Rule
rules.body: Brass appears only as a numeral, a 2px rule, or italic marker text; it never colours a surface, a button, or a heading.

rules.name: The Ground Is the Only Surface Rule
rules.body: Sections are bands of the same ground separated by hairlines; a different background appears only in the navy closing panel and inside photo frames.

rules.name: The One Weight Serif Rule
rules.body: The display serif is used only at weight 400. Emphasis comes from size and colour, never from a bolder serif.

rules.name: The 36em Measure Rule
rules.body: Descriptive paragraphs are capped at 36em; the hero sentence at 26em; the hero headline at 12ch.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Sections open with the serif heading itself. There are no eyebrows, overlines, or small-caps labels above headings.

rules.name: The Only the Button Casts Rule
rules.body: The primary button is the only element with a box-shadow. Containers, photos, headers, and bars never cast.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Box Rule
rules.body: When two things need separating, draw a 1px rule between them; do not wrap either in a bordered or shaded container.

dos: Do open every section with a 1px `{colors.rule}` top hairline and `clamp(48px, 7vw, 96px)` of vertical padding on the shared ground.
Do set every heading, numeral, and quote in Libre Caslon Display at weight 400; set everything else in Schibsted Grotesk.
Do reserve navy fills for the primary button and the closing panel, and spend navy elsewhere only as lines, outlines, text, focus, and selection.
Do mark emphasis with a 2px top rule: brass for patient words, navy for places.
Do cap running text at 36em, the hero sentence at 26em, and the hero headline at 12ch.

Do ship exactly one entrance moment per page (hero rise plus photo unveil) and, at most, one settle on a list, all on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and all removed under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
Do keep the 2px navy focus outline at 4px offset on every focusable element, and navy-on-white text selection.
Do draw icons, when unavoidable, as inline stroke SVGs in currentColor at 2 to 2.2px; the page has two (logo tooth, WhatsApp mark).
Do hold photos in 6px frames at fixed ratios (1:1 hero on desktop, 4:5 portraits, 16:8 doors) with warm grading and candid subjects.
donts: Don't put content in cards, tiles, or bordered boxes; separate with hairlines instead.
Don't add box-shadows to anything but the primary button; surfaces, photos, headers, and bars stay flat.
Don't add kickers, eyebrows, overlines, or uppercase labels above headings.
Don't fill any area with brass or use brass on headings or buttons.
Don't use the display serif at any weight other than 400, or set body copy in it.
Don't introduce a third background colour beyond the ground and the navy closing panel.
Don't show star ratings, review counts, or rating figures anywhere; quotes carry a name and a source line only.

Don't treat the prototype's stand-ins as final: the putty gradient photo fields, the "Photo to supply" captions, the brass italic "to confirm" markers, and the inline tooth logo are all placeholders that leave when the real logo, photographs, degrees, BMDC number, opening time, reviewer names, and associate names arrive.
Don't carry the Google Fonts `<link>` into the Astro build; the fonts are owed as self-hosted subsets.
